description: Add browser use, vision, and money-making capabilities to phantom-mesh agent

userStories.title: Playwright browser tool
userStories.description: As a user, I want the agent to browse the web via Playwright so that it can research, scrape, and automate web tasks
acceptanceCriteria: src/tools/browser.rs exists with BrowserTool implementing Tool trait
Tool supports actions: navigate, snapshot, click, type, screenshot, get_text
Uses Python playwright subprocess (spawns a helper script)
Helper script created at ~/.phantom-mesh/browser_helper.py
Tool registered in ToolRegistry
cargo test passes (lib tests)
At least 3 unit tests for BrowserTool

userStories.title: Gemini free-tier vision provider
userStories.description: As a user, I want the agent to use Google Gemini free API for vision and reasoning so that it can analyze screenshots and think better than llama3.2:1b
acceptanceCriteria: src/providers/gemini.rs exists implementing Provider trait
Supports text chat and vision (base64 image input)
Uses generativelanguage.googleapis.com REST API
Model default: gemini-2.5-flash-lite or gemini-2.0-flash
Registered in ProviderRouter when gemini_api_key is configured
agents.toml supports [providers.gemini] section
cargo test passes
At least 3 unit tests

userStories.title: Vision analyze tool
userStories.description: As a user, I want a vision_analyze tool so that the agent can understand screenshots and web pages visually
acceptanceCriteria: src/tools/vision.rs exists with VisionTool implementing Tool trait
Takes image path or URL, sends to Gemini/Groq for analysis
Returns structured text description of visual content
Falls back across providers: Gemini -> Groq -> local description
Tool registered in ToolRegistry
cargo test passes
At least 2 unit tests

userStories.title: Approval gate for risky actions
userStories.description: As a user, I want the agent to ask my approval via Telegram before financial or destructive actions so that I stay in control
acceptanceCriteria: src/approval.rs exists with ApprovalGate struct
Sends Telegram message with action description + inline Yes/No buttons
Waits up to configurable timeout (default 5 min) for user response
Configurable: which tool names require approval
Returns Approved/Denied/Timeout result
cargo test passes
At least 3 unit tests

userStories.title: Hands workflow engine
userStories.description: As a user, I want a Hands system so that the agent can run structured multi-step workflows for specific money-making tasks
acceptanceCriteria: src/hands/mod.rs exists with Hand struct and HandRunner
Hand definition loaded from TOML files (~/.phantom-mesh/hands/<name>/hand.toml)
Each Hand has: name, description, phases (list of system prompts), tools, schedule, output_format
HandRunner executes phases sequentially, each phase is one agent call
Phase outputs chain as context to next phase
Telegram commands: /hands (list), /hand <name> [args] (run)
cargo test passes
At least 4 unit tests

userStories.title: Lead Generation Hand
userStories.description: As a user, I want a lead generation hand so that the agent can autonomously find potential clients/leads from the web
acceptanceCriteria: ~/.phantom-mesh/hands/lead/hand.toml created with 4 phases: ICP definition, web research, lead scoring, report generation
Uses tools: web_search, browser, file_write, memory_store
Outputs structured lead report (CSV + summary) to workspace
Configurable: industry, location, company size, keywords
Hand loads successfully and appears in /hands list
cargo test passes

userStories.title: Web Research Hand
userStories.description: As a user, I want a deep research hand so that the agent can produce comprehensive research reports on any topic
acceptanceCriteria: ~/.phantom-mesh/hands/researcher/hand.toml created with 5 phases: question decomposition, multi-source research, cross-referencing, synthesis, report generation
Uses tools: web_search, browser, file_write, memory_store
Outputs structured research report (Markdown) with source citations
Configurable: depth (quick/standard/deep), format (brief/detailed/academic)
Hand loads and appears in /hands list
cargo test passes

userStories.title: Content Creator Hand
userStories.description: As a user, I want a content creation hand so that the agent can generate social media posts, articles, and marketing content
acceptanceCriteria: ~/.phantom-mesh/hands/content/hand.toml created with 3 phases: topic research, content generation, quality review
Supports content types: tweet, thread, article, email_copy
Style presets: professional, casual, witty, educational
Outputs content with approval queue (file in workspace for review)
Hand loads and appears in /hands list
cargo test passes

userStories.title: Email send tool
userStories.description: As a user, I want the agent to send emails via SMTP so that it can do outreach, notifications, and deliver reports
acceptanceCriteria: src/tools/email.rs exists with EmailTool implementing Tool trait
Supports SMTP send (to, subject, body, optional HTML)
SMTP config in agents.toml: [email] host, port, username, password (encrypted)
Requires approval gate for sending
Tool registered in ToolRegistry
cargo test passes
At least 3 unit tests

userStories.title: Groq free-tier vision provider
userStories.description: As a user, I want Groq as a fallback vision provider so that the agent has ~14,400 free vision calls/day
acceptanceCriteria: src/providers/groq.rs exists implementing Provider trait
Uses OpenAI-compatible API at api.groq.com
Supports vision via Llama 4 Scout model
Registered as fallback after Gemini in provider router
agents.toml supports [providers.groq] section
cargo test passes
At least 2 unit tests

userStories.title: Wire all new features into main.rs and Telegram
userStories.description: As a user, I want all new features (browser, vision, hands, email, approval) wired into the running daemon so they actually work end-to-end
acceptanceCriteria: Browser tool registered when playwright is available
Vision tool registered when Gemini/Groq API key configured
Hands loaded from ~/.phantom-mesh/hands/ on startup
Telegram commands: /hands, /hand <name>, approval Yes/No handling
Email tool registered when SMTP configured
Gemini and Groq providers added to router when configured
cargo test passes
cargo build --release succeeds

userStories.title: pyautogui E2E test of all new features
userStories.description: As a user, I want a comprehensive pyautogui test to verify all money-making features work via HTTP API and Telegram
acceptanceCriteria: test_money_agent.py exists with pyautogui tests
Tests HTTP: /tools shows new tools (browser, vision, email)
Tests HTTP: /hands lists available hands
Tests Telegram: /hands command shows hands list
Tests Telegram: browser navigation to a URL
Tests Telegram: /hand researcher with a topic
Screenshots saved to ~/Desktop/test_money_agent/
All API tests pass programmatically
